title: Silver's Supply Deficit: Why Mine Production Can't Keep Up With Growing Demand
description: Silver demand exceeded mine supply by 211 million ounces in 2023, the third consecutive annual deficit. Where the demand is coming from and what it means for physical holders.
alt: Silver supply deficit showing 211 million ounce gap between 1.2 billion ounce demand and 998 million ounce supply in 2023
